Ā. -भवति, ˚ते (ind.p. -भूय, q.v.), to be or come together, assemble, meet, be joined or united with (instr. with or without सह, or loc.), RV. &c. &c.; to be united sexually with (instr. with or without सह, or सार्धम्, or acc.), AV.; ŚBr.; MBh. &c.; to be born or produced from (abl.), arise, spring up, develop, ib.; to happen, occur, be, be found, exist, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to be possible, Hit.; Vedāntas.; to be or become anything (nom.), RV.; Br.; MBh.; to accrue to, fall to the share of (loc. or gen.), R.; Kathās.; to prevail, be effective, ŚBr.; to be able to or capable of (inf. or loc.), Śiś.; to enter into, partake of, attain to (acc.), Yājñ.; to find room in, be contained in or numbered among (loc.), RV.; MBh. &c.; to be adequate, MBh.; to be capable of holding, Pāṇ. v, 1, 52 : Caus. -भावयति, to cause to be together, bring together, present or affect any one (acc.) with (instr.; with दोषेण, ‘to attach blame to’, with अन्नेन, ‘to give food to’), Kāv.; Kathās.; BhP. ; to cause to be born or produced, effect, accomplish, make, AitBr.; MBh. &c.; to foster, cherish, MBh.; to resort to (acc.), ib.; to meet with, find (जीवन्तीम्, ‘alive’), Hcar.; to honour, revere, salute, greet, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to receive or accept graciously, Pañcat.; to imply, suggest a possibility, suppose anything possible in any one (loc. or gen.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to regard or consider as (two acc.), Kālid.; Pañcat.; to think it possible that (Pot. with and without यद्, or fut.), Pāṇ. iii, 3, 155, Sch.; (with न) to think it impossible that (Pot. with and without यद्, यच्च, यत्र, यदा, यदि, or जातु; fut. with and without किं किल), Pāṇ. iii, 3, 145 &c. s: klI, (samBUya militvA samutTAnaM karmmakaraRaM yatra .) militvEkamatyA baRijAM karmmakaraRam । tattu vivAdapadaviSezaH । yaTA, samBUyasamutTAnaM nAma vivAdapadamidAnImaBidaDAti । “samavAyena baRijAM lABArTaM karmma kurvvatAm । lABAlABO yaTAdravyaM yaTA vA saMvidA kftO ॥” sarvve vayamidaM karmma militAH kurmma ityevaMrUpA sampratipattiH samavAyastena ye baRiNnawanarttakapraBftayo lABalipsavo BUtvA prAtisvikaM karmma kurvvate tezAM lABAlABAvupacayO yaTAdravyaM yena yAvadDanaM paRyagrahaRAdyarTaM dattaM tadanusAreRAvaseyO । yadbA । praDAnaguRaBAvaparyyAlocanayAsya BAgadbayamasyEko BAga ityevaMrUpayA saMvidA samayena yaTA saMpratipattO taTA veditavyAM । kiYca । “pratizidDamanAdizwaM pramAdAt yacca nASitam । sa taddadyAdviplavAcca rakzitAddaSamAMSaBAk ॥” tezAM samBUya pracaratAM maDye paRyamidamitTaM na vyavaharttavyamiti pratizidDamAcaratA yannASitaM anAdizwamananujYAtaM vA kurvvARena taTA pramAdAt prajYAhInatayA vA yena yannASitaM sa tatpaRyaM baRigByo dadyAt । yaH punastezAM maDye cOrarAjAdijanitAt vyasanAt paRyaM pAlayati sa tasmAdrakzitAt paRyAt daSamamaMSaM laBate । “arGaprakzepaRAdviMSaM BAgaM SulkaM nfpo haret । vyAsidDaM rAjayogyaYca vikrItaM rAjagAmi tat ॥” iha yataH paRyasyeyanmUlyaM ityarGastasya prakzepaRAt rAjanirUpaRAdDetorasO mUlyAdviMSatitamamaMSaM SulkArTaM gfhRIyAt । yat punarvyAsidDamanyatra na vikreyamiti rAjYA pratizidDam । yacca rAjayogyaM mARikyAdyapratizidDamapi tadrAjYe anivedya lABaloBena vikrItaYcedrAjagABimUlyadAnanirapekzaM tat sarvvaM paRyaM rAjApaharedityarTaH । “miTyA vadan parImARaM SulkasTAnAdapAsarat । dApyastvazwaguRaM paYca savyAjakrayavikrayI ॥” yaH punarbbaRik SulkavaYcanArTaM parImARaM nihnute SulkagrahaRasTAnAdvApasarati yaScAsyedamasya vetyevaM vidAdAspadIBUtaM paRyaM krIRAti vikrIRIte vA te sarvve paRyAzwaguRaM daRqanIyAH । api ca । “tarikaH sTalajaM SulkaM gfhRan dApyaH paRAn daSa । brAhmaRaprAtiveSyAnAmetadevAnimantraRe ॥” SulkaM hi dbiviDaM sTalajaM jalajaYca । tatra sTalajamarGaprakzepaRAdbiMSaM BAgaM SulkaM nfpo haredityuktam । jalajantu mAnave'Bihitam । “paRaM yAnaM tare dApyaM puruzo'rdDapaRantare । pAdaM paSuSca yozicca pAdArdDaM riktakaH pumAn ॥ BARqapUrRAni yAnAni tAryyaM dApyAni sArataH । riktaBARqAni yatkiYcit pumAMsaYcAparicCadAH ॥” Sulkadbaye'pyayamaparo viSezaH । “na BinnakArzApaRamasti SulkaM na SilpavfttO na SiSO na dUte । na BEkzyalabDe na hftAvaSeze na Srotriye pravrajite na yajYe ॥” iti । tIryyate'neneti taro nAvAdistajjanyaSulke'DikftastarikaH sa yadA sTalodBavaM SulkaM gfhRAti tadA daSapaRAn daRqanIyaH । veSo veSma prativeSa iti svaveSmAmimuKaM svaveSmapArSvasTaM cocyate tatra BavAH prativeSyAH । brAhmaRASca te prAtiveSyASca brAhmaRaprAtiveSyAstezAM Srutavfttasampa nnAnAM SrAdDAdizu viBave satyanimantraRe etadeva daSapaRAtmakaM daRqanaM veditavyam ॥ * ॥ deSAntaramftabaRigrikTaM pratyAha । “deSAntaragate prete dravyaM dAyAdabAnDavAH । jYAtayo vA hareyustadAgatAstErvinA nfpaH ॥” yadA samBUyakAriRAM maDye yaH kaSciddeSAntaraM gato mftastadA tadIyamaMSaM dAyAdaH puttrAdyapatyavargaH bAnDavAH mAtfpakzIyAH mAtulAdyAH jYAtayo'patyavargavyatiriktAH sapiRqA vA AgatAH samBUyavyavahAriRo ye deSAntarAdAgatAste vA gfhRIyustErvinA dAyAdyaBAve rAjA gfhRIyAt । vASabdena ca dAyAdInAM vEkalpikaM aDikAraM darSayati । pOrvvAparyyaniyamastu patnI duhitara ityAdi pratipAdita evAtrApi vijYeyaH । SizyasabrahmacAribrAhmaRanizeDo baRikprAptiSca vacanaprayojanam । baRijAmapi maDye yaH piRqadAnarRadAnAdisamarTaH sa gfhRIyAt । sAmarTyAviSeze punaH sarvve baRijaH saMsfzwino viBajya gfhRIyustezAmaBAve daSavarzaM dAyAdyAgamanaM pratIkzyAnAgatezu svayameva rAjA gfhRIyAt tadidaM nAradena spazwamuktam । “ekasya cet syAt maraRaM dAyAdo'sya tadApnuyAt । anyo vAsati dAyAde SaktaScet sarva eva te ॥ tadaBAve tu guptaM tat kArayeddaSavatsarAt । asvAmikamadAyAda daSavarzasTitaM tataH ॥ rAjA tadAtmasAt kuryyAt evaM Darmmo na hIyate ॥” kiSca । “jihmaM tyajeyurnirlABamaSakto'nyena kArayet .” jihmo vaYcakaH taM nirlABaM nirgatalABaM lABamAcCidya tyajeyuH bahizkuryyuH । yaSca samBUyakAriRAM maDye BARqapratyavekzaRAdikaM karttumasamarTo'sAvanyena svaM karmma BARqaBAravAhanaM tadAyavyayaparIkzaRAdikaM kArayet । iti mitAkzarA ॥
